schema:name: Lao national health portal
schema:description: Lao PDR national health portal and gateway (Country B, XXH): Lao PDR's national FHIR server behind the OHS FHIR Info Gateway (J4.0, J4.1): assembles each family member's IPS and DVCs, issues each as a passcode-protected Verifiable Health Link in an HCERT signed with Country B's DSC, hosts the manifests (ITI-YY5), checks passcode, expiry and consent on each request, and logs every access as an AuditEvent at home. Country B is played on the GDHCN DEV network by the fictional participant XXH, so no real ministry's key is implied.
